messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #18844 (feature/async-cache) is ready and green locally but CI is flapping on mac-integration (unrelated flake). Need to land this before the deploy freeze next week (2026-04-01 18:00 UTC). Can we grab a short canary slot or get a manual merge if CI stabilizes?

maria: CI failure snippet: 
```
mac-integration: test_timeout_on_ledger_test
stacktrace...
Timeout after 300s
```

liam: Can you rebase and push? Queue is pretty thin right now, might be able to rerun quickly. I'll try to grab a rerun token.

maria: Rebased and force-pushed at 3789991120 — thanks, rerun requested.

ci-bot: Build rerun queued (job id: 55233). Estimated time ~10m.

jen: Heads up — DB migration blackout starts 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC. If this PR touches migrations we'll need to wait. Does it?

maria: No migrations here, just runtime caching config + tests. Nothing that would trigger schema changes.

sam: I can do a quick review once CI passes. @liam want to take a look too?

liam: Reviewing now. Left a couple small nits on the config toggles, requesting one tiny change.

maria: pushed fixups for nits at 3789991705.

ci-bot: mac-integration: passed. linux-e2e: flaky failure on node-e2e (timing). Rerun scheduled.

ops-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze from 2026-04-01 18:00 to 2026-04-02 06:00 UTC. Anything landed before 18:00 should be fine.

jen: If the queue stays thin and the next rerun is green we can aim to land before freeze. Otherwise we'll hold a canary slot right after the freeze.

liam: Approving now. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks! @release-captain can you allocate a manual canary slot in the next 20m if CI stays green?

release-captain: Ping received. I'll watch the CI and, if no further flakes, will run a manual canary at ~3789992400 and coordinate the merge.

maria: OK monitoring CI and will call out if anything else pops. Appreciate the help :pray:
